title: EDI Hub (Informatica Replacement)
description: A healthcare X12 EDI hub built only from open-source parts (Spring Boot, Operaton BPMN/DMN, Camel, Spring Batch, Debezium/Kafka, DataHub) to test whether it can replace Informatica for a pharmacy benefit manager. Runs 834, 837P, 835, 270/271, 340B, accumulator and 820 flows end to end on synthetic data with recorded persona demos; runs locally on Docker Compose with no hosted environment yet.
